ComfyUI AnimateDiff 的工作流程 - 文本到动画

你可以轻松运行这个ComfyUI AnimateDiff 工作流程在舒适UI云，专门为ComfyUI量身定制的平台。所有必要的节点和模型均已预设并可立即使用！

另外，您还可以在以下位置找到许多其他出色的 ComfyUI 工作流程：润康网站.

此 ComfyUI AnimateDiff 工作流程包括跨版本 V3、SDXL 和 V2 的高级 AnimateDiff 功能，专注于不同的动画风格。创建动画后，Latent Upscale 使用两种方法增强分辨率：具有可自定义设置的传统潜在升级和 Control Net Assisted Latent Upscale，可在保留原始设计的同时精确改善视觉效果。

AnimateDiff 简介

AnimateDiff 可将文本到图像模型（例如稳定扩散）的图像动画化，从而为静态图片添加运动，而无需进行特定于模型的调整。它集成了一个运动建模模块，该模块经过视频剪辑训练，可实现逼真的运动动力学，从而提供通用动画解决方案。

AnimateDiff 的版本

动画差异 V3：AnimateDiff V3 采用先进的动画技术和域适配器 LoRA 模块，专注于复杂的运动处理。它引入了新的运动功能，增强了创作过程，但并不总是超越 V2。

AnimateDiff SDXL：AnimateDiff SDXL 适合 1024x1024 分辨率的高清视频创作，支持各种宽高比。在 Beta 版中，它专注于提高动画质量，并预计会有所改进。

动画差异 V2：AnimateDiff V2 通过更好的分辨率和批量大小训练来提高质量，采用 MotionLoRA 来控制缩放、平移、倾斜和滚动等摄像机运动，非常适合动态视觉叙事。

Workflow of ComfyUI AnimateDiff - Text to Animation

You can easily run thisComfyUI AnimateDiff WorkflowinComfyUI Cloud, a platform tailored specifically for ComfyUI. All essential nodes and models are pre-set and ready for immediate use!

Plus, you'll find plenty of other great ComfyUI Workflows on theRunComfy website.

This ComfyUI AnimateDiff workflow includes advanced AnimateDiff features across versions V3, SDXL, and V2, focusing on diverse animation styles. After creating animations, Latent Upscale enhances resolution using two methods: traditional latent upscaling with customizable settings and Control Net Assisted Latent Upscale, which precisely improves visuals while preserving the original design.

Introduction to AnimateDiff

AnimateDiff animates images from text-to-image models like Stable Diffusion, adding motion to static pictures without needing model-specific tweaks. It integrates a motion modeling module trained on video clips for realistic motion dynamics, offering a universal animation solution.

Versions of AnimateDiff

AnimateDiff V3:AnimateDiff V3 features advanced animation technologies with the Domain Adapter LoRA module, focusing on complex motion handling. It introduces new motion capabilities, enhancing the creative process without always surpassing V2.

AnimateDiff SDXL:AnimateDiff SDXL caters to high-definition video creation at 1024x1024 resolution, supporting various aspect ratios. In Beta, it focuses on elevating animation quality, with improvements expected.

AnimateDiff V2:AnimateDiff V2 improves quality through better resolution and batch size training, featuring MotionLoRA for controlling camera movements like Zooming, Panning, Tilting, and Rolling, ideal for dynamic visual storytelling.
